en: Sepia-toned divided postcard with two photographs on the front. The upper image shows an industrial mining complex with a prominent tall shaft or tower-like building surrounded by ancillary structures and rail tracks leading toward it, captioned in Hungarian "Szent István akna." The lower image shows a broad street or open field with a large, multi-storey institutional building with balconies and a small tower or dome, captioned "Mecsekszabolcs. Legényotthon." The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, printed Hungarian publisher information, an address to Budapest, and a green Hungarian postage stamp cancelled at Pécs.
